name: Ku Klux Klan
description: The Ku Klux Klan (KKK) is the oldest and most notorious white supremacist organization in the United States, founded December 24, 1865 in Pulaski, Tennessee by six Confederate veterans. It has operated in three distinct eras — Reconstruction (1865–1870s), revival (1915–1944, peak membership 4 million), and modern fragmented form (1946–present, ~5,000 members across 40+ independent factions) — carrying out terrorism, lynchings, bombings, and hate crimes against Black Americans, Jews, Catholics, immigrants, and LGBTQ individuals.
aliases: Knights of the Ku Klux Klan
